page_title: TOT 4-1 AST | Tottenham Hotspur v Aston Villa 03/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

raw: van de Ven M. Thigh Injury

commentary.text: 90+10' Craig Pawson is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+10' Yves Bissouma (Tottenham) had an opportunity from long range. His low shot was directed towards the middle of the goal, but Emiliano Martinez was alert and made a comfortable save.
90+6' 4 - 1 James Maddison (Tottenham) sets the ball for the free kick and fires in a beautiful strike, which nestles exactly in the top right corner.
90+5' Diego Carlos (Aston Villa) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Tottenham.
90+4' Dangerous play by Jaden Philogene (Aston Villa). Craig Pawson blows his whistle for a foul.
90+3' Tottenham keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
90' There will be a minimum of 10 min. of added time.
90' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
89' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
87' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
87' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. It will be a corner kick for Aston Villa.
84' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) sends a cross into the box, but Guglielmo Vicario comes off his line to gather the ball.
84' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Jaden Philogene (Aston Villa).
82' Here comes a substitution. Archie Gray is brought on as a substitute for Destiny Udogie (Tottenham).
82' Ange Postecoglou is forced to make a change. Richarlison (Tottenham) is unable to continue due to injury, James Maddison comes on.
81' Substitution. Jaden Philogene (Aston Villa) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Jacob Ramsey walks off.
81' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Youri Tielemans as he is replaced by Boubacar Kamara (Aston Villa).
81' Unai Emery has decided to substitute John McGinn and he is replaced by Leon Bailey (Aston Villa).
80' Richarlison (Tottenham) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
79' 3 - 1 It's 3:1! Richarlison feeds Dominic Solanke (Tottenham) inside the box, who is unmarked and buries the ball in the bottom right corner.
78' Amadou Onana (Aston Villa) receives a pass and decides to smash the ball from long range, but his poor effort sails high over the bar.
78' The attendance for today's match is 61253.
77' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
77' Craig Pawson sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
76' The Tottenham players halt their celebrations as referee Craig Pawson makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
75' 2 - 1 GOAL - 2:1! Dejan Kulusevski found Dominic Solanke (Tottenham) inside the box, he spotted goalkeeper Emiliano Martinez off his line and chipped the ball into the net. What a cheeky lob!
71' Jacob Ramsey (Aston Villa) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
69' The substitution is prepared. Jhon Duran (Aston Villa) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Morgan Rogers.
68' Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
67' Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) smashes a shot at goal from the edge of the area that drifts harmlessly past the right post.
65' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
64' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
63' Craig Pawson has a clear sight and sees a foul from Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham). Free kick. Aston Villa will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
61' Substitution. Cristian Gabriel Romero makes way for Ben Davies (Tottenham).
60' Unai Emery is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Matty Cash suffers an injury and Diego Carlos (Aston Villa) comes on.
60' The game is interrupted now, Cristian Gabriel Romero (Tottenham) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
59' Matty Cash (Aston Villa) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
58' Craig Pawson shows a yellow card to Cristian Gabriel Romero (Tottenham) for his blatant foul.
57' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
56' Ange Postecoglou prepares a substitution. Heung-Min Son is replaced by Richarlison (Tottenham).
56' Substitution. Yves Bissouma has come on for Rodrigo Bentancur (Tottenham).
55' John McGinn (Aston Villa) smashes the ball with a volley from the edge of the box, but his poor attempt goes miles wide of the left post.
54' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Craig Pawson had an easy-decision to make.
52' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) darts into the box and immediately fires a first-time effort. He produces a poor shot which goes well over the crossbar.

51' Dominic Solanke (Tottenham) latches on to a precise pass and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper. He fires a low shot towards the left side of the net, but Emiliano Martinez leaps like a salmon to deny him.
51' A corner kick by Tottenham is thwarted by the well prepared Emiliano Martinez (Aston Villa).
49' 1 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Heung-Min Son plays it into the box, and Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) gets on the end of the cross to put it into the back of the net. 1:1.
48' Rodrigo Bentancur (Tottenham) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
47' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) commits a rough foul. Craig Pawson stops the game and makes a call.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+1' Craig Pawson blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
43' Rodrigo Bentancur (Tottenham) rushes a shot from long range and subsequently sends it high over the bar.
42' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. His effort sails well wide of the right post.
42' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
41' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
39' Aston Villa seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
38' The corner from Pedro Porro (Tottenham) is intercepted by Emiliano Martinez.
37' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
36' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball is out of play and Tottenham manage to earn a corner.
35' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Emiliano Martinez, who smothers the ball.
32' 0 - 1 GOAL - 0:1! The corner comes over and Pau Torres flicks on with his head to Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa), who makes no mistake and fires the ball into the back of the net.
31' Tottenham force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
30' What a brilliant piece of goalkeeping! Guglielmo Vicario dived superbly to deny Amadou Onana (Aston Villa), whose header was directed to the bottom right corner.
30' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) launches a cross from the corner, but Guglielmo Vicario is alert to thwart the effort.

30' That's unlucky! Jacob Ramsey (Aston Villa) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared. Aston Villa have been awarded a corner kick.
29' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 53:47.
26' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
26' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) whips a long ball in from the free kick which is intercepted by Guglielmo Vicario.
25' Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Craig Pawson no option but to blow his whistle.
24' Destiny Udogie (Tottenham) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
23' Craig Pawson blows his whistle. John McGinn (Aston Villa) commits a foul after dangerous play.

22' Rodrigo Bentancur (Tottenham) receives a quality pass and unleashes a rocket of a shot from distance, but his amazing effort goes just over the crossbar. The goalkeeper probably wouldn't have saved this one.
22' The resulting corner from Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.

22' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Tottenham.
20' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
20' Destiny Udogie (Tottenham) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball goes behind for a corner. Tottenham will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
18' Rodrigo Bentancur (Tottenham) receives the ball and has a go from distance, but he shouldn't have bothered as it sails high over the bar.
18' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
17' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) takes a short corner kick.
17' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted. Tottenham have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
15' The referee blows his whistle as Rodrigo Bentancur (Tottenham) was too aggressive in his challenge.
14' Dominic Solanke (Tottenham) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His header is badly mistimed and sails high over the bar.
13' Jacob Ramsey (Aston Villa) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Craig Pawson saw the whole situation. Tottenham are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
12' Destiny Udogie (Tottenham) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
11' Great teamplay by Tottenham as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
9' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Aston Villa.

8' John McGinn (Aston Villa) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away.
7' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Craig Pawson blows for a foul.
6' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) misses a big chance! He fires the ball high over the crossbar from inside the 6-yard box after the ball rebounded to him.
4' Craig Pawson blows for a foul after Destiny Udogie (Tottenham) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
3' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
2' Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
1' The match has just started.
The players are on the pitch and Aston Villa will have the kick-off.
Craig Pawson is the one to supervise the game today.
